raw_snippet: Our 2022 paper predicted that high-quality text data would be fully used by 2024, whereas our new results indicate that might not happen until 2028.
note: Villalobos et al., 'Will we run out of data?' (Epoch, 6 Jun 2024). Same page: 'Our 80% confidence interval is that the data stock will be fully utilized at some point between 2026 and 2032.' The 2028 figure is the compute-optimal central case; stored as the point estimate with the CI in this note.
